metadata.title: Timestamp fidelity, workspace dep validation, and import/export row filters
metadata.description: Three additive, backward-compatible enhancements: (1) importer preserves bead created_at/updated_at by patching the persisted item front matter after create/update + dep-wiring, making the timestamp round-trip lossless (opt-out --no-preserve-timestamps); (2) beads validate cross-checks dangling deps against the current pm workspace via SDK listAllFrontMatter (fallback pm list-all), downgrading workspace-resolvable deps to a cross_workspace_dependency warning (opt-out --no-workspace); (3) --filter-status/--filter-type on import and export to selectively process a subset.

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.

metadata.title: preflight: fail-fast Beads-JSONL schema gate before import
metadata.description: Register a preflight override that runs the existing structural validator (validateBeadsText) against the import input file BEFORE the importer touches the pm store. On any structural error the import aborts immediately with a clear, line-naming message and a non-zero exit, so no partial/garbage items are created. Valid files pass silently. Scoped strictly to the import path (pm beads import + pm beads-import alias); export and validate are never blocked. Adds preflight to manifest capabilities.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.resolution: Added a registerPreflight override scoped to the import path that runs validateBeadsText on the input file before any pm-store write; aborts via process.exit on structural errors (SDK swallows thrown preflight errors), silent pass-through on valid. Added 'preflight' to manifest capabilities; existing caps audited as truthful. README + header docs updated.
metadata.expected_result: Malformed JSONL aborts import immediately with a clear line-naming error + non-zero exit and zero items created; valid JSONL imports normally with deps/timestamps round-tripping; export and validate not blocked.
metadata.actual_result: Exactly as expected: malformed -> exit 1, 'nothing was imported', list-all count 0; valid -> 3 imported, 1 dep linked, 1 timestamp preserved, exit 0; export exit 0; beads-validate works + not gated; legacy beads-import alias and --dry-run both gated.
metadata.close_reason: Preflight Beads-JSONL schema gate implemented, built, unit-tested (29/29), and functionally proven end-to-end with real data on the pm CLI.
